crossRefs.note: They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, and unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.
You shall roast and eat it in the place which Yahweh your God chooses. In the morning you shall return to your tents.
“From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them. He has spread a net for my feet. He has…

translations.web: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.
translations.bsb: Do not eat any of the meat raw or cooked in boiling water, but only roasted over the fire—its head and legs and inner parts.
translations.kjv: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance
translations.asv: Eat not of it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roast with fire; its head with its legs and with the inwards thereof.
